procedural_matters: Marc de Haas (coach of NED 221341) and Francesco Caricato (coach of ITA 221817) attended a hearing as an observer. Ron Barak and Gonzalo Heredia (members of the International Jury) gave evidence as witness.
facts: NED 221341 sailing 1 boat length above layline to the mark 2 leeward of ITA 225817, both boats on starboard.
ITA 221817 on starboard sailing 3 boat lengths above the layline to the mark 1 boat length clear ahead of NED 221341 and ITA 225817.
At the mark NED 221341 sailed between the mark and ITA 221817, distance between the mark and NED 221341 was 1 m, distance between NED 221341 and ITA 221817 was 1 boat length.
NED 221341 sailed about 40 seconds and then took a Two-Turn Penalty.
conclusions: ITA 221817 clear ahead of NED 221341 when entering the zone was entitled to mark-room, but she made space available to NED 221341 to enter inside and round a mark (World Sailing Case 63).
